title: A Day Longer Than a Year?
fact: Venus takes about 243 Earth days to rotate once, but only about 225 Earth days to orbit the Sun.

title: An Animal With Three Hearts
fact: An octopus has three hearts. Two pump blood to the gills, while one pumps it to the rest of the body.

title: Can You Hear Sound in Space?
fact: Sound needs a medium such as air or water to travel. In the near vacuum of space, ordinary sound cannot travel between spacecraft.

title: Lightning Is Extremely Hot
fact: A lightning channel can heat the surrounding air to about 30,000 kelvin for a brief moment.

title: Sharks Are Older Than Trees
fact: Shark ancestors existed hundreds of millions of years ago, before the earliest known trees appeared.

title: Footprints on the Moon
fact: Without wind or rain like Earth's, footprints on the Moon can remain for a very long time, though micrometeorites gradually alter the surface.
